title: OKR Decomp Lab: Engineering → GTM hand-off notes (WIP)
content:
Purpose: quick lab to translate high-level company OKRs into actionable engineering and GTM commitments, surface cross-team dependencies, and draft an all‑hands segment that signals intent and asks. This is a working note — very rough.

High-level framing (one sentence): make inference predictable and economical for production teams — reduce 95th percentile latency variance by 20% while cutting per-token inference cost by 15% in Q2.

Attendees (workshop): Marcus (serving runtime), Ava (product/console), Diego (infra), Priya (growth/gtm), Sofia (facilitator). Scoped invite list for follow-ups: eng-serving-runtime, product-hosted-api, go-to-market.

Agenda (60m):
- 0–10m: alignment on company KR targets and metrics we care about (latency p95, per-token cost, customer adoption of Dedicated)
- 10–30m: break out — engineering maps features/epics that move the needle (autoscaling policy delta, batching/caching work, quantization enablement)
- 30–45m: GTM maps commercial asks (customer beta slots, migration incentives, playbook for Dedicated sell)
- 45–55m: sync — identify top 3 cross-team dependencies, owners, and blocker risks
- 55–60m: decide all-hands narrative + 2 asks for leadership

Notes from breakout (engineering):
- Feature candidates that materially affect KR1/KR2:
  - Autoscaler policy v2 (fast ramp + prewarm): reduces cold-start p95 for short bursts — owner: Marcus — rough ETA: 8 weeks if deprioritize minor infra refactor.
  - Prefix KV caching integration with hosted API: big win for conversational product patterns — owner: Diego + eng-sdk — ETA: 6 weeks with a beta toggle.
  - Continuous batching runtime change: lower cost but risk of latency tail regressions — owner: Marcus — needs A/B and per-route SLOs.
  - Quantization profiles for 7B/13B model variants: 10–12% CPU/GPU token cost improvements; testing needed for quality drift on eval prompts — owner: Research team (Nora) / product — dependency: eval harness.

Notes from breakout (GTM/Product):
- Adopted asks to move deals and show momentum:
  - 20 beta seats for Dedicated (target customers list in linked artifacts). Need a simple migration checklist and SLA cheat-sheet — owner: Priya — ETA: 3 weeks.
  - All-hands demo: show 2 short customer stories (before/after latency + cost) and a 90-second runtime demo of autoscaler prewarm in action. Need a script and 1‑pager.
  - Sales enablement: pricing play showing per-token cost delta with/without caching/quantization for sample workloads.

Top 3 cross-team dependencies and mitigations:
1) Eval harness and prompt set readiness (Research + Product): blocker for quantization rollout. Mitigation: triage 30 representative prompts this sprint; allocate 1 eng day to integrate into CI. Owner: Nora.
2) Canary infra + rollback hook (SRE + Serving): required before continuous batching A/B. Mitigation: define rollback criteria and automated rollback playbook. Owner: Diego.
3) Beta customer onboarding flow (GTM + Console): must be smooth to hit 20 seats. Mitigation: ship a short migration checklist + dedicated SE hours for first 10 customers. Owner: Priya.

Risk register (quick, prioritized):
- Regressions in output quality from quantization (likelihood: medium, impact: high) → need prompt-level regression alerts and automatic fallback to float variant.
- Latency tail increase from batching changes (likelihood: medium-high, impact: medium) → require per-route p95 SLOs and canary window.
- Underfilled Dedicated beta (likelihood: low-medium) → need clearer incentive and faster SE onboarding.

All‑hands slot plan (3 mins + 2 Qs + CTA):
- Narrative arc: 1) Problem: production economics still unpredictable for many teams; 2) What we're doing this quarter: v2 autoscaler, caching, quantization tests, Dedicated beta; 3) Proof points: internal perf curves + one customer delta; 4) Ask: signups for beta, feedback for migration flow, and help triage eval prompts.
- Visuals needed: a single slide with p95 latency vs time (baseline vs new policy), a tiny before/after cost table, demo gif of prewarm.
- Ask to execs (two asks):
  - Approve headcount carve for 1 SRE for the next 2 sprints to accelerate canary infra (reason: single-point blocker).
  - Endorse a short-term incentive: $10k credit pool for first 10 Dedicated migrations to accelerate commitments.

Exec update talking points (30–60s each):
- Status: we have 3 prioritized engineering initiatives mapped to the company KR; preliminary perf sims show 10–18% cost reduction potential for typical convo workloads.
- Blockers: eval harness coverage and canary infra are highest-risk items; need exec sign-off on temporary SE allocation and small credit pool.
- Ask: greenlight the cost pool and 2-week acceleration window for SRE hire.

Draft OKR decomposition (company OKR -> suggested team KR):
- Company Objective: Production-grade inference at scale (Q2).
  - Company KR1: Reduce inference p95 variance by 20%.
    - Eng/Serving Runtime KR: deploy autoscaler v2 to 90% of production routes with prewarm (owner: Marcus) — metric: percent routes with prewarm enabled.
    - SRE KR: reduce cold-start incidents by 50% (owner: Diego).
  - Company KR2: Lower per-token inference cost by 15% for hosted API customers.
    - Product/Optimize KR: ship caching suggestions + default toggle for top 10 routes (owner: Ava) — metric: percent eligible tokens served from cache.
    - Research/Models KR: validate quantized 13B profile within 2% quality delta on eval set (owner: Nora).

Open questions / to validate:
- Which 30 prompts are most representative for our top 10 hosted customers? (Priya to pull list)
- Do we have a quick billing experiment path to show per-token cost deltas in the console? (Product / Billing)
- What is the minimal SRE spec needed to unblock canary infra? (Diego + hiring)

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Priya: assemble top 30 customer prompt set and share by 2026-02-20.
- Marcus: prototype autoscaler prewarm in staging and record demo by 2026-02-27.
- Diego: draft rollback criteria and canary playbook doc by 2026-02-24.
- Ava: draft all-hands slide + one-pager for beta by 2026-02-25.
- Nora: run quantization smoke tests on the 7B profile with 10 representative prompts by 2026-03-03.

Meeting artifacts to produce:
- Short playbook: "Dedicated beta migration checklist" (1 page).
- Internal perf notebook with before/after traces for autoscaler demo.
- One Confluence page linking all tickets + owner matrix (placeholder id in linked_artifacts).

Notes to self (Sofia):
- Keep the all-hands segment tight — 3 slides, 3 minutes. Avoid deep technical detail.
- Make asks concrete (numbers and deadlines) — execs respond to specific asks.
- Follow-up: schedule engineering/gtm weekly 30m sync until the beta fills.

TODOs and known follow-ups:
- Confirm whether billing can surface token-level cost deltas in a demo mode (ask Billing team, cc: @janelle).
- Add a short script for demo runner to ensure reproducible demo (record steps).

Quick links (working list):
- stg perf traces: https://internal.redwood/staging/traces/okrlab-02
- beta-candidate list (sheet): https://sheets.redwood/beta-list-2026
- slack thread: https://slack.redwood/archives/C0OKRLAB/p123456789

Next sync: quick follow-up on 2026-02-23 (15m) to confirm owners and unblock actions.

End of notes. This doc is intentionally thin — convert to a confluence iteration once owners confirm and action items start closing.
